insurer_name: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Top-up plan with deductible per policy year. Standard health-insurance waiting periods aligned with IRDAI Excl01/02/03.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Indemnity above deductible up to Sum Insured.
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Room, ICU, OT, anaesthesia, blood, oxygen, surgical appliances, drugs, diagnostics, implants. AYUSH included under inpatient when in AYUSH Hospital.

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Home treatment > 3 days when transfer impossible or no room.

ayush_coverage.notes: Inpatient AYUSH treatment in AYUSH Hospital.

notable_exclusions_summary: HDFC ERGO Optima Plus is a high-deductible top-up plan; covers same scope as base indemnity once deductible is exceeded.
